headline: Your Photos' Invisible Shrinking Trick
source: JPEG (Joint Photographic Experts Group) Standard; Digital Image Processing Fundamentals

slides.speaker: camera
slides.title: Photos Shrink? 🤯
slides.bubble: Wait, your phone actually shrinks every photo you take?!

slides.speaker: vj
slides.title: The Invisible Trick 🪄
slides.bubble: Yes! It uses clever compression, like JPEG, to save space.

slides.speaker: camera
slides.title: Artist's Secret 🎨
slides.bubble: So, it simplifies details without changing how we see it?

slides.speaker: vj
slides.title: Your Take? 👇
slides.bubble: Exactly! Thousands of photos stored. Is this a good trade-off?

takeaway: Your phone uses clever 'compression' algorithms, like JPEG, to shrink photos. This saves massive space, making them appear identical while storing thousands.
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know how your phone stores thousands of photos in tiny files? 🤯

💡 Your phone uses clever 'compression' algorithms, like JPEG, to shrink photos. This saves massive space, making them appear identical while storing thousands.
